title: ibUMAP: Coherent and Scalable Field Evaluation for UMAP Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.01445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: UMAP achieves scalable layout optimization through stochastic negative sampling. However, this stochasticity can lead to unstable embeddings across reruns and downstream reuse, as the estimated repulsive forces depend on the ordering of sampling events. We present ibUMAP, a coherent field-based alternative that evaluates attraction and repulsion from a shared embedding snapshot and applies them synchronously. Its degree-weighted repulsive field is motivated by the conditional expectation of negative sampling for a fixed embedding and represented by three scalar moments, which are evaluated efficiently on CPUs and GPUs using an interpolation-based FFT scheme. This formulation avoids explicit all-pairs computations while inducing optimization dynamics that differ from those of standard online UMAP. translated_title: ibUMAP：面向UMAP优化的连贯且可扩展的场评估方法
translated_abstract: UMAP通过随机负采样实现了可扩展的布局优化。然而，这种随机性可能导致嵌入结果在重复运行和下游复用时不稳定，因为估计出的排斥力依赖于采样事件的发生顺序。我们提出了ibUMAP，一种连贯的基于场的替代方案，它从共享的嵌入快照中评估吸引力和排斥力，并将二者同步应用。其按度加权的排斥场以固定嵌入下负采样的条件期望为理论依据，并由三个标量矩表示，这些矩通过基于插值的FFT方案在CPU和GPU上高效计算。这种表述方式避免了显式的全对计算，同时产生了与标准在线UMAP不同的优化动态。受控实验表明，同步性和核截断会改变局部-全局保真度之间的权衡，而FFT评估仅产生较小的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ibUMAP，一种基于场的连贯UMAP优化方法，通过共享嵌入快照同步评估吸引力与排斥力，并利用基于插值的FFT方案高效计算按度加权的排斥场，从而解决随机负采样导致的嵌入不稳定问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ibUMAP, a coherent field-based alternative to UMAP that synchronously evaluates attraction and repulsion from a shared embedding snapshot and efficiently computes a degree-weighted repulsive field using an interpolation-based FFT scheme, resolving the embedding instability caused by stochastic negative sampling.
